description: Acquired cross-section tables: published 13 TeV NLO+NLL tables whose redistribution is not confirmed. A row carries no numbers; it pins the public archive, the member and their sha256, and the numbers are installed into the cache at first use (ravel xsec acquire). Rows have the registry row schema.

licence_terms.finding: The NLL-fast grids are published by the code authors for download. No licence or redistribution terms appear on the download page, on the start page of the same site, or in the archive, so redistribution is not confirmed and the grids are acquired from the authors' site rather than shipped. Cite the program version and the papers each row lists.

evidence_read.finding: Download page of the NLL-fast programs; lists version 3.1 (13 TeV) with grids for MSTW2008NLO, CTEQ6.6M and NNPDF3.0NLO and the papers to cite; states no licence.
Start page of NNLL-fast, the successor, at 13.6 TeV; states no licence and points to NLL-fast for NLO+NLL predictions with previous PDF generations.
Archive nllfast-3.1-13tev.tar.bz2 (Last-Modified 2022-10-13): the program source and 27 grid files; no licence or copying notice in any member.
Working-group page (revision r10): the table is NNLO approx+NNLL with PDF4LHC21; the only NLO+NLL item is an attached comparison plot, so the working group page holds no NLO+NLL table.
Working-group page: NNLO approx+NNLL, ten-fold squark degeneracy, decoupled gluinos; no NLO+NLL table.
Working-group page: NNLO approx+NNLL for stop and sbottom; no NLO+NLL table.

tables.comment: NLO and NLL+NLO sbottom-antisbottom production. The program documentation directs the stop grid to be used with the sbottom mass in place of the stop mass; contributions from initial-state bottom quarks are stated to be numerically negligible. Scale uncertainty from mu between m/2 and 2m, m being the average mass of the produced pair; the central scale is mu = m.
tables.note: Same grid file as the stop pair; the documented sbottom rule is the only difference.
